newsitem.title: CHINA: China stops demolition of warlord's former home.
newsitem.headline: China stops demolition of warlord's former home.

text.p: Authorities in eastern China have stopped demolition of the former residence of a warlord built in 1912 and listed as a national historical site, officials said on Friday.

The Shandong provincial Relics Bureau ordered construction workers to stop demolition of the former residence of warlord Zhang Huaizhi in Jinan city because city officials did not have permission to do so, a bureau official said by telephone.

Acting on orders of the Jinan municipal Urban and Rural Construction Committee, construction workers had begun tearing down Zhang's former residence and worked in the middle of the night to escape detection, the official said.
Zhang's former residence, now a park, was being demolished to make way for a commercial complex. The relics bureau had begun repairs to the site.
City officials defended the demolition, saying the workers were simply moving the residence to another site, state television said.
